title: Structural / Competitive-Family Redistribution
scientific_question: Does an economically constrained family state contain structural inconsistency that predicts subsequent correction, beyond target self-movement and broad event movement?
regime_policy: never pool PRE_ELECTION and ACTIVE_RESULTS for primary estimation, testing, FDR or promotion
sampling: as-of right edge minus 1ns; no interpolation; stale/missing remains missing
canonical_side: exact outcome label Yes only, matching accepted 004A.2 policy

hard_structural_object.state: p(t) = vector of contemporaneous canonical-Yes midpoints for the frozen usable family subset
hard_structural_object.exhaustive_projection: Euclidean projection to probability simplex {q in [0,1]^n: sum q = 1}
hard_structural_object.nonexhaustive_projection: Euclidean projection to {q in [0,1]^n: sum q <= 1}; if sum(p)<=1 then p*=p
hard_structural_object.nested_projection: unweighted isotonic projection enforcing nonincreasing probability with increasing seat threshold
hard_structural_object.primary_direction: future delta p should align with -r(t)
hard_structural_object.economically_meaningful_effect: beta_structural >= 0.10 at 30s, meaning at least 10% of the contemporaneous inconsistency is corrected per primary horizon

hard_controls: target own midpoint change over prior 30s
broad event midpoint movement over prior 30s excluding the entire tested family
target quote age scaled by the frozen 300s freshness limit
hard_model: future_target_change = intercept + beta_structural*(-r_i) + controls; beta_structural is the primary coefficient
hard_family_rule: A full proven partition may use sum p=1 only when every required member is in the frozen usable scope. Otherwise the frozen subset is only mutually-exclusive nonexhaustive and may use sum p<=1. No renormalization is permitted.

soft_competitive_object.signal: For target i, S_-i(t) = -mean of sibling midpoint changes over the prior 30s using every other frozen usable sibling with valid as-of data.
soft_competitive_object.indirect_target_leakage: forbidden; event-common control also excludes the entire target family
soft_competitive_object.target: target midpoint change over the next 30s
controls: target own midpoint change over prior 30s
broad event midpoint movement excluding the entire target family
soft_competitive_object.expected_direction: positive coefficient on the oriented S_-i signal
soft_competitive_object.interpretation: semantic competitive redistribution only; never probability conservation

nulls.time_circular_shift: shift structural residual/sibling signal relative to future movement within event-regime-family; preserve regular 30s clock and missingness
nulls.time_block_permutation: permute contiguous 20-bin (10 minute) signal blocks within event-regime-family
nulls.membership_null: randomize family membership within the same event/regime while preserving frozen family size where possible and matching member quote-update activity quartile; otherwise mark unavailable
nulls.wrong_family_control: apply the same family statistic to an event/activity-matched group without the proven relationship
nulls.direction_falsification: test observed correction toward the feasible set against the away-from-set sign
nulls.semantic_only_negative_control: semantic groups are evaluated in the soft family and never receive hard-identity evidentiary weight

multiple_testing.unavailable_policy: unavailable preregistered cells remain recorded and count in the planned family size; no p-value is invented

evidence_scopes.cross_family_warning: COL_2026, PER_2026 and HUN_2026 are only three independent election families

evaluation_folds.discovery_within_event: chronological 60% train / 20% development / 20% holdout inside each event/regime when a fitted control model is required; labels crossing fold boundaries are purged
evaluation_folds.challenge: locked whole event/regime windows; no feature, family, projection, horizon or architecture selection from challenge outcomes
evaluation_folds.joint_model_selection: discovery TRAIN/DEVELOPMENT only; challenge cannot select rank, penalty or architecture

STRUCTURAL_REDISTRIBUTION_SUPPORTED: at least one preregistered hard-mechanical 30s family/regime has q<=0.01 under the frozen time null
direction falsification points toward rather than away from the feasible set
membership/wrong-family controls do not produce comparable evidence
effect adds information beyond frozen controls
eligible evidence scopes show no material sign contradiction and at least two valid event/regime scopes support the same mechanism
SOFT_COMPETITIVE_EFFECT_ONLY: at least one soft competitive 30s family/regime survives q<=0.01 with positive leave-target-out effect
target leakage checks pass and controls do not remove the effect
promotion_logic.NO_STRUCTURAL_EDGE: valid hard and soft tests have adequate observations/nulls but fail the frozen promotion criteria
promotion_logic.INCONCLUSIVE: coverage, structural-violation incidence, independent event scope, or valid-null count is insufficient for a reliable disposition

executability.full_basket_requires: mechanically exhaustive family, every member present, fresh valid bid/ask, and executable depth on every leg
executability.partial_family_policy: no exhaustive basket claim; midpoint incoherence is never called arbitrage
executability.depth_limit: minimum executable size across every required leg

joint_followup.gate: only after a frozen discovery family survives the 1% FDR gate
joint_followup.model: joint linear family correction Delta p = A r + frozen controls
joint_followup.challenge_role: evaluation only; cannot rescue primary failure

forbidden: repairing family membership after challenge access
forcing an incomplete family to sum to one
using target information inside S_-i directly or indirectly
using robustness horizons to rescue a failed 30s primary test
